changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Update AI prompts to include Indian PII (PAN, Aadhaar) detection for data masking

column.name: prompt_content
prompt_content
column.value:
You are an expert data security AI assistant. Analyze this data masking request and extract the intent.
User Request: "{userRequest}"
Analyze and respond with ONLY valid JSON in this exact format: { "intentType": "mask_pii|mask_credit_cards|mask_names|mask_emails|mask_ssn|mask_phone|mask_pan|mask_aadhaar|custom", "targetFields": ["field1", "field2"], "targetTables": ["table1", "table2"], "maskingStrategy": "partial|full|hash|tokenize|format_preserving", "userRole": "admin|user|all|non-admin|specific_role", "confidence": 0.95, "originalRequest": "{userRequest}", "reasoning": "Brief explanation of why this strategy was chosen", "preserveChars": 4, "maskChar": "*", "requiresConfirmation": true, "hasAmbiguity": false, "clarificationNeeded": "" }
Rules: 1. For emails: suggest partial masking (j***@example.com) 2. For SSN/Credit Cards: suggest full masking or partial with last 4 digits 3. For names: suggest partial masking (J*** D***) 4. For passwords: suggest full masking or hashing 5. For Indian PAN (Permanent Account Number): use mask_pan, partial masking preserving last 4 chars 6. For Indian Aadhaar number: use mask_aadhaar, partial masking preserving last 4 digits 7. Set confidence based on clarity of request (0.0-1.0) 8. Set requiresConfirmation=true for ambiguous requests 9. Identify common field names (email, ssn, credit_card, name, pan, pan_number, aadhaar, aadhar, etc.)

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
👋 Hi! I'm your AI assistant for data masking policies.
I'm here to help you protect sensitive data in your **{assetName}** database.
You can tell me things like: • "Mask all personally identifiable information" • "Hide credit card numbers except the last 4 digits" • "Protect customer email addresses" • "Mask SSNs for non-admin users" • "Mask Indian PAN (Permanent Account Number) fields" • "Hide Aadhaar numbers"
I'll analyze your database schema, suggest the best masking strategies, and help you apply them safely.
What would you like to protect today?

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
I understand you want to create a data masking policy, but I'm currently not available in your region for AI processing.
**Your request:** "{userMessage}"
**What you can do:** 1. **Use Manual Policy Creation** - Go to the masking policies section and create rules manually 2. **Specify Exact Fields** - Tell me the exact table and field names you want to mask 3. **Use Rule-Based Detection** - I can suggest common sensitive fields based on naming patterns
**Common masking patterns:** • Email fields: `user_email`, `email`, `mail` → Partial masking (j***@example.com) • SSN fields: `ssn`, `social_security` → Full masking (***********) • Credit card: `credit_card`, `cc_number` → Partial masking (****-****-****-1234) • Names: `first_name`, `last_name` → Partial masking (J*** D***) • Indian PAN: `pan`, `pan_number`, `pan_no` → Partial masking (ABCDE****A) • Indian Aadhaar: `aadhaar`, `aadhar`, `aadhaar_number` → Partial masking (1234****5678)
Would you like me to show you the available fields in your database, or would you prefer to use the manual interface?

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
I want to make sure I understand your request correctly.
You said: "{userMessage}"
Could you please be more specific? For example: • Which type of data do you want to protect? (emails, names, SSNs, PAN, Aadhaar, etc.) • Should it be fully hidden or partially visible? • Who should see the masked data? (all users, non-admins, etc.)
The more details you provide, the better I can help you create the right masking policy.

column.name: prompt_content
column.value:
Here are the available fields in your database schema:
**Schema Information:** {schemaInfo}
**To create a masking policy:** 1. Tell me which specific fields you want to mask 2. Specify the masking strategy (partial, full, hash) 3. Define who should see the masked data
**Example requests:** • "Mask the email field in the users table" • "Hide SSN fields for non-admin users" • "Partially mask credit card numbers" • "Mask PAN (Indian Permanent Account Number) fields" • "Hide Aadhaar numbers"
You can also use the manual policy creation interface for more control.
